Physicist Eric Weinstein and actor Terrence Howard share the mic in episode 2171 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Howard had gone viral for his own claims about math and physics, and Weinstein came ready to test them. Rogan hosts what became one of the show's most tense science talks.

Howard lays out his belief that basic math is flawed and that he has found a truer system. Weinstein answers claim by claim, defending standard math and asking for clear proof. The clash stays polite but sharp for hours. Listeners get a rare front-row seat to a real argument about truth itself.
